notes: Identity assessment: Academia HTML transcription contains the primary journal report, including methods, results, Table 2, and conclusions, rather than an abstract alone. Title, authors Peter F. Delaney, Jacqueline A. Goldman, Jake S. King, Rosemery O. Nelson-Gray, journal Personality and Individual Differences 83 (2015) 180–184, and DOI 10.1016/j.paid.2015.04.020 match the assigned reference (canonical L0–L12). Two-column text is interleaved; no PDF supplied. Original side unassigned and not inspected. The report uses short-form MT18, not an identified MTQ48 commitment subscale. No unsupported mapping to MT18 total or Big Five conscientiousness is made. Table 2 forget-condition List 2 candidates: Consc .31* and MT18 .15; the * p < .05 applies to Consc, not MT18. Neither is selected for the commitment target. MT18 List 2 has no numeric p/bound printed; lack of a star is not a numeric bound. R–F is a different outcome. Planned recruitment 120 and two forget-group exclusions are contextual counts only; no N derived from df or assumed allocation. General directed-forgetting replication claims do not establish a commitment/List 2 verdict.
